title: Private deploy scratchpad - Acme Corp VPC prep
content:
Context:
- Onsite prep notes for Acme Corp private deployment (VPC + on-prem proxy). Customer wants a VPC-connected install first, then a fully air-gapped on-prem bundle if VPC testing successful.
- Primary contact: Lina Ortiz (Acme infra), secondary: Dan Wu (security).
- Customer constraints: strict egress via corporate proxy, FIPS crypto requirement for key operations, HSM-backed KMS (Thales), only whitelisted IPs allowed.

Quick summary of last run (2026-03-04):
- Bootstrap succeeded on controller node (ami-based image), but worker nodes fail to pull Redwood images (401 from internal registry) when behind customer proxy.
- NVIDIA driver install step passed; container runtime failed at nvidia-container-toolkit postinstall (permission denied in /usr/local/nvidia).
- Model artifacts sync (rsync -> S3-compatible MinIO) partially complete - 12/20 shards downloaded; failures show TLS handshake errors to S3 endpoint (customer proxy blocking TLS SNI?).

Environment details (from Lina):
- VPC CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16
- Subnets: private 10.20.1.0/24 (workers), private 10.20.2.0/24 (control), public 10.20.3.0/24 (bastion/NAT)
- Proxy: proxy.acme.internal:3128 (explicit HTTP proxy for all egress)
- KMS/HSM: Thales Luna 7.x, connector on management VLAN; customer will provide CA certs
- Object store: MinIO (s3.acme.internal) over HTTPS with private cert signed by acme-root-ca

Install checklist (working):
- Controller node: prepare AMI -> done
- System packages: yum update, kernel-headers installed -> done
- Docker + nvidia-container-toolkit -> attempted (see blocker)
- Systemd units for redwood-runtime.service -> templated, needs env var substitution (REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH)
- SSH bastion access confirmed for Lina's team

Blockers & Observations:
1) Container registry auth / manifest pull failures behind proxy
   - Symptoms: docker pull returns 401/403 or TLS handshake errors when proxy is set.
   - Notes: The customer's proxy does TLS interception; our registry client needs to trust acme-root-ca. We tried adding cert to /etc/docker/certs.d/registry.redwood.local/ca.crt on one worker -> still failing. Need: list of proxy whitelisted domains or allowlist for registry IPs.
   - Action: ask Lina for proxy logs for failed requests; request temporary allowlist for registry.redwood.local and s3.acme.internal.

2) nvidia-container-toolkit postinstall permission denied in /usr/local/nvidia
   - Logs: postinstall script attempts chown/chmod on /usr/local/nvidia, errors as user 'root' inside install chroot complaining about immutable bit (?); suspiciously the AMI has /usr/local mounted from custom NFS with root squash.
   - Workaround: pre-create /usr/local/nvidia with correct permissions before running toolkit install; or ask Ops to remount without squash for the install window.

3) MinIO TLS handshake failures on sync
   - Client error shows that client does not trust acme-root-ca; we uploaded CA to runner nodes but rsync/mc still fails intermittently.
   - Hypothesis: proxy performing MITM with per-host cert (SNI-based) and our Go client using different TLS stack; need to import CA into system-wide trust store and into Go runtime trust bundle used by sync tool.

4) HSM/KMS integration questions
   - Customer requires HSM-backed keys for data-at-rest encryption and signing of rollout manifests.
   - Need: HSM connector credential exchange procedure (they want us to run an agent that talks to HSM on management VLAN). Security wants an architectural diagram and RPC ports.
   - Action: schedule call with customer security to get HSM connector spec and firewall rules. Add to PD-3421.

Temporary notes / commands tried:
- docker pull --config /etc/docker/proxy-config ... -> still 403
- sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/nvidia && sudo chown root:root /usr/local/nvidia && sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/nvidia then reran toolkit -> progressed further, new error related to /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnvidia-ml.so missing -> kernel driver mismatch.
- openssl s_client -showcerts -connect s3.acme.internal:443 -servername s3.acme.internal -> cert chain shows acme-intermediate issued by acme-root-ca (good). Need to import acme-root-ca into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and update-ca-trust.

Unresolved questions:
- Does Acme want our runtime to call home for model catalog check-ins? They said no external calls in locked-down mode - need explicit offline bundle process. (If so, produce offline bundle and shipping instructions).
- HSM: will they provide a network-reachable IP for connector or do we need to run an agent inside their network?
- Are there port-forwarding constraints for NCCL (worker-to-worker) when running multi-GPU across hosts in their private VLAN? Raise with SRE.

Short-term TODO (prioritized):
- [ ] Get proxy allowlist for registry.redwood.local and s3.acme.internal (owner: Lina) -> blocker for image pulls
- [ ] Import acme-root-ca into system + Go trust stores on the bootstrap AMI (owner: Samira)
- [ ] Adjust AMI build to create /usr/local/nvidia with permissive perms before nvidia toolkit install (owner: Rashid)
- [ ] Confirm kernel + driver matrix for customer host image (owner: Miguel) -> match NVIDIA driver package
- [ ] HSM connector spec call (owner: Evelyn) -> schedule this week
- [ ] Prepare offline model bundle + install docs if customer denies outbound (owner: Samira)

Acceptance tests (manual):
- docker pull: controller and worker can pull redwood images behind proxy using provided CA and proxy creds
- model sync: mc ls s3/acme-bucket -> list all shards without TLS errors
- runtime smoke: run redwood-runtime --smoke-test -> returns OK and can load small quantized model

Notes for the docs/PRs to update:
- private-deploy-scripts/ami-builder: add CA import step and precreate /usr/local/nvidia (PR: #89)
- docs/private-deploy/offline-bundle.md: draft outline for packaging models and manifests for air-gapped installs
- runbook: add troubleshooting steps for proxy TLS interception and HSM connector onboarding

Meeting notes to paste into Confluence after sync:
- Ask Lina for exact proxy cert chain and whether proxy rewrites SNI.
- Confirm maintenance window for remounting /usr/local without root squash (ops team).
- Confirm HSM architecture + list of ports.

If stuck: escalate to Kevin (eng lead) for making a temporary open egress path for initial bootstrap (we only need to reach registry.redwood.local and s3.acme.internal for first 24h).

Log snippets (for quick copy into ticket):
- "docker: Error response from daemon: Get \"https://registry.redwood.local/v2/\": net/http: TLS handshake timeout"
- "nvidia-container-toolkit postinstall: chown: changing ownership of '/usr/local/nvidia': Operation not permitted"
- "sync: failed to handshake with s3.acme.internal: EOF"

Last quick thoughts: prepare a small offline test image (tarball) that we can scp to workers as a fallback. Also create a short cheat-sheet for Lina with exact file paths we will update on AMI so their Ops can pre-approve the changes.

Next steps (today):
- Send email to Lina requesting proxy allowlist + cert bundle (done? draft below)
- Patch AMI build (small change) and test locally with a VM that simulates proxy intercept (owner: Rashid)

Draft email to Lina (copy):
"Hi Lina, quick follow-up from yesterday's run - to unblock image pulls and MinIO sync we need either a temporary allowlist for registry.redwood.local and s3.acme.internal or your proxy CA bundle so we can import it on the AMIs. Also, can you confirm whether the proxy performs SNI-based MITM? If possible please share the proxy logs for failed pulls (timestamp 2026-03-04 15:10-15:30 UTC). Lastly, we need the HSM connector spec; could we schedule a 30 min call this week to go over network and credential exchange? Thanks - Samira"
